newsitem.title: UK: UK engineering turnover falls 0.5% 3mths to Nov.
newsitem.headline: UK engineering turnover falls 0.5% 3mths to Nov.

text.p: Total turnover of Britain's engineering industries fell 0.5 percent in the three months to November compared with the previous three months, the Office for National Statistics said on Tuesday.
This was due to a decrease of 0.9 percent in home turnover more than offsetting a 0.1 percent rise in export turnover.
Compared with the same period a year ago, total turnover fell by 0.5 percent.
Total orders on hand at the end of November increased by 1.8 percent compared with the level at the end of August but were 1.8 percent down on November 1995.
